cohort: Placentae were collected from 20 mothers whose babies had infantile hemangiomas and 27 control mothers whose babies did not, with cases and controls matched for gestational age.
finding: Placentae from mothers of babies with infantile hemangiomas exhibited dramatically lower ACE2 expression, significantly lower placental weight, and a higher frequency of subclinical chorioamnionitis compared to control placentae.
cross-section timing: Placental samples were collected between 2016 and 2022.
gest_age: Gestational age was matched between cases and controls.
